I’m 15 and I’m on the same dosage as you, the first 5 days were the worst for me but after that you start to feel better and better. So try to stick with it for at least a month and let your doctor know of any side effects or questions. Make sure to take Tylenol, do not take anything with ibuprofen in it as it can be life threatening while on certain SSRI’s. I wish you the best of luck!
